verdict.rationale: Scoped API credentials are a fair question for a SaaS automation platform, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows a single organization API key that can be found, copied and rotated, plus organization-level limits (skyvern-docs-43). Nothing documents issuing multiple keys with restricted scopes or permissions per agent. Stored website logins with model placeholders (skyvern-docs-36) cover a different capability, protecting target-site secrets, and earn no credit here.
